title: Tickets keep the screenshots and files sent to them, stored safely until purged

requirements.text: genlock attach ID FILE --why copies the file into a project store and records it on the ticket or goal; the original can then be deleted
requirements.check: tests/attach.mjs: attach, delete original, stored copy still readable

requirements.text: genlock show lists each attachment with the full stored path, so an agent can open it
requirements.check: tests/attach.mjs: show output contains the stored path

requirements.text: The store is outside git (no binaries committed) but inside backups
requirements.check: tests/attach.mjs: git check-ignore on the stored file passes; backup archive contains it

requirements.text: genlock purge removes stored files (by ticket, by finished tickets, or older than a date) only with --user-said, and the record then says it was purged
requirements.check: tests/attach.mjs: purge without --user-said refused; with it file gone and show says purged
